name: The Peninsula Hong Kong
positioning: Luxury hotel on Salisbury Road in Kowloon, Hong Kong, with a Rolls-Royce and Bentley fleet, twin helipads and long-running restaurants such as Gaddi's and Spring Moon
best_for: Travelers who want chauffeured car or helicopter transport
Diners interested in Cantonese, French and Swiss restaurants with decades of history

facts.text: The hotel is on Salisbury Road in Kowloon, Hong Kong.
Spring Moon has held one Michelin star for ten consecutive years, 2017 to 2026.
Spring Moon has a dedicated tea counter with over 25 selected Chinese teas.
The Lobby offers all-day international dining and classic English Afternoon Tea.
Chesa has served Swiss Alpine cuisine in a chalet setting since 1965.
Guests in the Marco Polo Suite get complimentary use of a Rolls-Royce Phantom with a personal chauffeur.
Deluxe Courtyard Rooms overlook the hotel's historical forecourt and fountain.
The indoor pool has a classically Roman poolside setting with views of the Hong Kong skyline.
The fitness centre has an open-air terrace overlooking Victoria Harbour.
The spa uses product lines including Margy's Monte Carlo and Voya.

highlights.text: The hotel offers helicopter transport and flightseeing from its twin helipads.
The hotel's fleet includes Rolls-Royce Extended Wheelbase Phantoms and four Bentley Bentayga Extended Wheelbase Azure SUVs.
Gaddi's has served French cuisine since 1953 and pioneered the city's first Chef's Table experience.
Felix serves modern European cuisine high above Victoria Harbour in a space designed by Philippe Starck.
Six spa treatment rooms have views over Victoria Harbour, and a couples' spa suite has a harbour-view whirlpool tub for two.

considerations.text: The hotel is 33.9 km from the airport.
The minimum age for The Peninsula Spa is 16, and spa treatments require advance reservation.
Spring Moon requires closed-toe shoes, long trousers and sleeved shirts for gentlemen at dinner.
